title: zscalerctl dump error
description: Schema for each newline-delimited JSON object in a dump's errors.ndjson. Each line is a value-free per-resource failure record.

product.description: Product family of the failed resource.

name.description: Resource name of the failed resource.

kind.description: Failure classification; never includes live values.

reason.description: Why a live read failed, from a closed value-free vocabulary: credentials_rejected (sign-in refused with 400, 401 or 403), unauthorized (401), forbidden (403: the API role or licence does not allow it), not_found (404 on a list/show endpoint), rate_limited (429), server_error (5xx), client_error (other 4xx), transport (network failure), timeout (the request hit --timeout), pagination_incomplete (the CLI refused a list it could not prove complete), decode_failed (the response did not match the expected shape), not_subscribed (the feature is not licensed), unknown. Present only for live read failures.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed request, when there was a response.

retryable.description: True when a retry (or a longer --timeout) could plausibly succeed: rate_limited, server_error, transport, timeout. Omitted when false.
